list.label: FCA — Free Carrier
list.note: The buyer contracts and pays the air carriage. The seller delivers the cargo cleared for export to the carrier at the departure airport.

list.label: CPT — Carriage Paid To
list.note: The seller pays the air carriage to the destination airport. Risk passes to the buyer when the cargo is handed to the first carrier.

list.label: CIP — Carriage and Insurance Paid To
list.note: As CPT, and the seller also takes out cargo insurance for the benefit of the buyer.

list.label: DAP — Delivered At Place
list.note: The seller bears every cost to the named place except import clearance, duties and taxes.

insurance.note: Applied on CIP only, on the weight charge plus the declared value of the goods. Both figures are zero until the programme sets its own rate, so the CIP insurance line shows at zero and is flagged.

road_haulier.name: Haulier Services
road_haulier.note: Inland transport is quoted by this company, not by the airline. With the url blank the pre-carriage and on-carriage lines still appear, simply without a link.

quote.endpoint_note: Apps Script web app /exec URL. Leave blank to hide the send-by-email panel.
